queries.bars: SELECT symbol,session_date,feed,adjustment_asof,open::text,high::text,low::text,close::text,volume::text,available_at,acquired_at,content_hash FROM daily_bars ORDER BY symbol,session_date
queries.coverage: SELECT provider,symbols,started_at,ended_at,acquired_at,status,detail FROM information_fetches ORDER BY status,detail::text
queries.detection_outcomes: SELECT detection_id,horizon,realized_return,resolved_at,provenance FROM detection_outcomes ORDER BY detection_id,horizon
queries.documents: SELECT provider,url,content_hash,acquired_at,payload FROM source_documents ORDER BY provider,url,content_hash
queries.events: SELECT job_id,event,detail FROM job_events ORDER BY id
queries.facts: SELECT symbol,metric,tag,period_start,period_end,unit,value::text,filed_date,available_at,acquired_at,content_hash FROM financial_facts ORDER BY symbol,metric,tag,content_hash
queries.information: SELECT id,provider,external_id,symbols,created_at,updated_at,available_at,acquired_at,payload FROM information_versions ORDER BY id
queries.jobs: SELECT id,kind,payload,status,attempts,result,error FROM jobs ORDER BY id
queries.metrics: SELECT symbol,as_of,calculation_version,inputs_hash,payload FROM calculated_metrics ORDER BY symbol,inputs_hash
queries.outcomes: SELECT forecast_id,resolved_at,realized_return,spy_return,entry_bar_id,exit_bar_id,provenance FROM forecast_outcomes ORDER BY forecast_id
queries.runs: SELECT id,kind,symbols,status,result,error FROM ingest_runs ORDER BY id
